name: Math Field
description: Field formatter that evaluates a text field's value as a simple arithmetic expression (+, -, *, /, parentheses, decimals) with a hand-written lexer and parser, and renders the computed result.
project_description:
Math Field (Mathematical Expression Field Formatter) 
 A simple lexer and parser that can compute simple mathematical operations using the most basic operators `+, -, *, /` and can correctly handle parentheses `()` and floating point operations (decimal numbers). It can NOT currently handle negative numbers or unary operations.

 It is implemented as a Drupal 8 service module and provides a text field formatter. The formatter currently displays errors inline.

 Usage: after enabling the module, create a text field on your content type and choose the `Math field formatter` at admin/structure/types/manage/CONTENT_TYPE/display. The formatter displays both the expression and the result (or an error message); the result is revealed on hover via a delayed CSS animation. Evaluation uses a hand-written lexer plus a shunting-yard parser (no eval()). Initial development by Giorgos Kontopoulos as a test exercise.
